name: NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship
description: For outstanding international freshmen from countries other than Singapore. Covers subsidised tuition after the MOE Tuition Grant, with annual living and accommodation support and a one-time computer allowance. Admission applicants are considered automatically; no separate scholarship application. The Tuition Grant requires a three-year employment bond with a Singapore-registered company. Renewal requires GPA 3.5 and other conditions.
notes: The published benefits include S$5,800 annual living, S$5,000 annual accommodation and S$1,750 one-time computer support. Medicine/Dentistry conditions differ; confirm the full terms. No deadline is invented.
